channel.description: Latest articles from Dialogue: A Journal of Mormon Thought (dialoguejournal.com)

item.title: Women Claiming Power in Mormonism - Dialogue Journal
item.description: A conversation with Amy Watkins Jensen and historian Fara Sneddon on how Mormon women have claimed authority, visibility, and power through history and contemporary activism.Slug

item.description: Dialogue: A Journal of Mormon Thought presents “Heretic and the Inversion of the Mormon Endowment.” Note that any footnotes/images and/or graphs are not included. For the complete experience of this article, please see the PDF/HTML…

item.title: Exploring Genesis: Gospel Study with Dialogue Board Members - Dialogue Journal
item.description: Come enjoy a thoughtful brainstorming session studying Genesis 1-11 (creation, Adam and Eve, Noah, Babel) and the relevant parts of Moses in the Pearl of Great Price with a roundtable of Dialogue board members.

item.title: Unity and Indigenous Erasure in the Book of Mormon: A Conversation with Thomas W. Murphy - Dialogue Journal
item.description: In this episode of Dialogue Out Loud, Caroline Kline interviews Thomas W. Murphy about Indigenous erasure, settler colonial narratives, and unity in the Book of Mormon, drawing on his Winter 2025 Dialogue article.

item.title: Faith Under Constraint: Sneaking to Church in Saudi Arabia: A Conversation with Stephanie Kilpatrick - Dialogue Journal
item.description: In this episode of Dialogue Out Loud, Stephanie Kilpatrick discusses her essay about secretly attending church in Saudi Arabia, exploring faith, belonging, and the meaning of worship under restriction.

item.title: Exploring the Abrahamic Stories: Gospel Study with Rebecca Nibley - Dialogue Journal
item.description: Rebecca Nibley considers the choices of Abraham and his family and the ripples that caused, for good and bad.

item.title: Reading Heretic Through Mormon Rituals: A Conversation with Ryan M. Springer - Dialogue Journal
item.description: Ryan M. Springer joins Dialogue editor Margaret Olsen Hemming and producer Daniel Foster Smith to discuss his Winter 2025 Dialogue article, “Heretic and the Inversion of the Mormon Endowment,” exploring how the horror film mirrors and inverts Mormon ritual, authority, and spiritual ascent.

item.description: Dale Lawton uses the covenants of Old Testament to look at how church members can be more open to working with other communities to do good in the world. Dale Gunn-Lawton is a Managing Director…

item.title: Exodus Narratives and Deliverance: Gospel Study with David Banack - Dialogue Journal
item.description: David Banack walks us through the Exodus narrative and ways to find meaning today. David Banack is a semi-retired attorney living in Jackson Hole, Wyoming. A teenage convert to the LDS Church, he attended BYU,…

item.title: Generations in Transition: Belief, Disaffiliation, and the Future of Mormonism - Dialogue Journal
item.description: New research from Jana Riess and Benjamin Knoll explores why Latter-day Saints leave or stay, highlighting generational shifts, political influence, and the complexity of Mormon faith transitions.
